understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +, with all goals occupied simultaneously to complete each level and ultimately win the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces move one grid cell per directional action, while walls can block movement and pushable blocks can be shifted when adjacent. Movement hints are only heuristic, so blocked-looking directions may still need testing. Multiple selectable pieces are controlled by clicking their pixel-coordinate positions; all pieces must be positioned on goals at the same time.
